sources.description: T-Motor's datasheet table for MN7005 KV230 with the P24*7.2" CF propeller at 24 V, as an image posted in post 17 of ArduPilot forum topic 144558 (data/flight-logs/inventory.json, bench table tmotor-datasheet-mn7005-kv230-p24x72).

T-Motor's product page for the P24*7.2 10 mm hole prop, 2 pcs per pair (store.tmotor.com/product/polish-carbon-fiber-24x7_2-10mm-hole-prop.html), read on 2026-11-07: two blades integrated, 'Weight(Single Blade)' 56 ± 2 g, taken as the mass of one propeller.

applicability: Diameter and pitch from the designation 24 x 7.2 inches in the datasheet; no blade geometry: a derived BET geometry rests on its listed assumptions.
